subject: MAP: Sequencing capacity reservations & procurement milestones for Q3 evaluation
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Green <sam.green@acme.ai>, cloudplatform-sales@acme.ai
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Sequencing capacity reservations & procurement milestones for Q3 evaluation

Hi Sam,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — great alignment on the evaluation goals and the internal ramp plan you outlined. I attached a lightweight Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft that sequences evaluation checkpoints with procurement milestones so we can avoid surprises on the Dedicated/Private side (lead times for GPU pool reservations tend to be the gating factor).

Key asks in this draft:
- Confirmation of your ideal evaluation window (you mentioned mid-August to mid-September).
- Target concurrent throughput for evaluation (tokens/sec or steady-state RPS) so we can size a temporary pool.
- Any procurement blackout dates or internal commit windows in July/August.

Notes on lead times (for transparency):
- Dedicated reservation procurement: 4–8 weeks for standard slab reservations, 8–12 weeks if you require specific private-hosted networking or on-prem approvals.
- GPU pool sizing: early conservative estimate attached (q3-gpu-pool-estimate.xlsx). We recommend reserving a small pilot pool for the eval start, then scaling to the committed pool if you move to Reserved Capacity.

I included a suggested sequence in the MAP: evaluation kickoff -> pilot pool reservation -> performance checkpoints -> procurement commit -> production pool handover. If that matches your internal cadence, we can lock dates and produce a DocuSign SOW for signatures.

Attachments: map-sequence-v1.pdf, q3-gpu-pool-estimate.xlsx

Next step: can you confirm your preferred eval start by end of next week? Once we have that, Sergio and Rishi will finalize the pool sizing and SOW template.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

From: Sam Green <sam.green@acme.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, cloudplatform-sales@acme.ai
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Sequencing capacity reservations & procurement milestones for Q3 evaluation

Neha —

Thanks for the clear MAP. Mid-August start still looks right for the evaluation (internal resource OK). A few clarifications:
- Evaluation window: Aug 16 — Sep 10 (roughly 4 weeks)
- Pilot throughput target: ~1500 RPS steady with 500 concurrent sessions (we'll provide sample traffic shape)
- Procurement: our procurement team has a freeze from Jul 20–Aug 3 for end-of-quarter approvals, so we should avoid signing major contracts in that window.

If we need a private deployment (VPC), approvals may push lead time toward the 8–12 week side. If we can accept a dedicated hosted pool for evaluation, we can do 4–6 weeks.

I reviewed the GPU estimates at a glance — Sergio/Rishi, feel free to suggest alternatives that might hit the latency targets without overcommitting.

Sam Green
Director, Cloud Platform
Acme.ai

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: MAP: Sequencing capacity reservations & procurement milestones for Q3 evaluation

Looping you in on Acme's clarified windows. I ran the attached estimate (q3-gpu-pool-estimate.xlsx) against their target 1500 RPS and 500 concurrent sessions. Quick summary:
- Pilot pool: 8 x A100-80GB equiv (quantized runtime) should cover the pilot with headroom for spikes.
- Production/Reserved pool: 32 x A100-80GB equiv for steady-state with 20% buffer for autoscaling.
- If they require Private/VPC with on-prem validations, add 2–3 weeks to provisioning and coordinate with infra on IP allowlists.

Action items for us:
1) Draft SOW with pilot and reserved tiers (SOW template attached: sow-draft.docx).
2) Prepare a DocuSign link once Sam confirms eval start and procurement blackout.
3) Provide a short runbook for migration from pilot -> reserved (we'll include KV cache priming steps and rollback).

I'll mark lead times clearly in the SOW: pilot provisioning (14–28 business days), reserved pool provisioning (30–60 business days depending on network requirements).

— Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Solutions Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Green <sam.green@acme.ai>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@acme.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Sequencing capacity reservations & procurement milestones for Q3 evaluation

Sam — thanks for the timing note. Noted the Jul 20–Aug 3 procurement freeze. To avoid hitting that window, we propose the following simple sequence:

1) Confirm evaluation start: Aug 16 — we will initiate pilot provisioning by Jul 30 to meet the Aug 16 target (provisioning estimate 10 business days for dedicated hosted).
2) Pilot run (Aug 16 — Sep 10) using dedicated hosted pool (8x A100 equiv).
3) Performance checkpoints week 2 and week 4 of the pilot — if we hit SLA targets, trigger procurement approval packet the week of Sep 13.
4) If Private/VPC is required after pilot, expect additional 2–3 weeks; we will surface the explicit network docs during the pilot.

I am attaching an updated MAP that marks these dates and the SOW we plan to use. If Proc (cc'ed) can provision a PO window around Sep 13–20, we should be able to close and schedule reserved pool provisioning for early Oct.

Attachments: map-sequence-v1.pdf, sow-draft.docx

Next step: Sam, please confirm Aug 16 and authorize me to send the DocuSign SOW after Jul 30 provisioning kick-off.

Best,
Neha

From: Sam Green <sam.green@acme.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, cloudplatform-sales@acme.ai, Procurement Team <procurement@acme.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Sequencing capacity reservations & procurement milestones for Q3 evaluation

Neha / team —

Confirmed: Aug 16 start works. Please proceed with the Jul 30 provisioning kick-off for the pilot pool. Procurement, please note the proposed Sep 13 approval packet and advise if any additional paperwork is needed before Jul 20.

Sergio/Rishi — thank you for the sizing. If you can include a lower-cost quantized config option (reduce to 6 x A100 equiv for pilot) as a contingency, that would help with internal budget sensitivity.

Sam
